description: One close record's canonical sha256 (RFC 8785 JCS, UTF-8), byte size and headline counts, plus the URL of the full record mirror. Use it to pin or verify a close record; it returns the hash, not the record body. For readable close stats use get_epoch.

epoch.description: closed epoch number; omit for the latest close

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

name: get_epoch_record
title: Close record hash
